A Comparative Study of VLMs for Food Ingredient Recognition and Nutrient Estimation
A comparative study of vision-language models for food ingredient recognition and nutrient estimation.
VLMs recognise ingredients (~60 % AP) but fail at nutritional arithmetic — grounding is mandatory.
Shows that external database grounding and deterministic math are essential.
Decomposing Food Images for Better Nutrition Analysis: A Nutritionist-Inspired Two-Step Framework
Decomposing food images for better nutrition analysis: a nutritionist-inspired two-step framework.
Two-step: visual decomposition (SAM2/FoodSAM), then nutritional reasoning.
Justifies two-step perception pipeline over end-to-end VLM estimation.
What is there in an Indian Thali? Indian Thali Dataset (ITD) and Weight Estimation Dataset (WED)
What is there in an Indian Thali? Introduced Indian Thali Dataset (ITD: 7.9k images) and Weight Dataset (WED: 1.4k images).
Covers dense multi-item platters (curries, dal, rice, flatbreads).
Provides datasets for Indian platter segmentation and portion estimation.
NutriVisRAG: Multimodal Exemplar Grounding for Nutritional Analysis Using Vector Databases
NutriVisRAG: Multimodal exemplar grounding for nutritional analysis using vector databases.
Vector DB retrieval eliminates LLM hallucination in nutrient values.
Blueprint for vector retrieval and RAG-based nutrient grounding.
OmniFood8K: Single-Image Nutrition Estimation via Hierarchical Frequency-Aligned Fusion
Single-image nutrition estimation via hierarchical frequency-aligned fusion (8,036 samples, 165 categories).
2D RGB models need scale anchors; depth absence causes large errors.
Highlights need for scale-anchored geometry and density priors.
Multimodal Information Fusion for Food Nutrition Estimation: A Survey on Estimation Bottlenecks
Multimodal information fusion for food nutrition estimation: a survey on estimation bottlenecks.
Classifies field into visual-geometric, semantic-knowledge, compositional, and uncertainty-aware fusion.
Theoretical backbone organizing our multimodal perception, knowledge retrieval, and confidence calibration.
